record.question: The isotope of carbon used in radiocarbon dating is
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: Radiocarbon dating measures radioactive carbon-14 in once-living material. The USGS explains that 14C decreases after an organism dies, so the remaining amount helps estimate when it died. The isotope used is therefore C-14, not the stable carbon isotopes.
